fullPassage: Teak is among the most prized of the tropical hardwoods. It is native to India, Thailand, and Vietnam. It is a leaf-losing species that requires an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color. Teak is strong, making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture. One problem with harvesting teak is that the wood is very dense, so that when it is first felled and has not been dried it sinks in water. It cannot be moved out of forests by floating down rivers unless the wood has been dried first.

questions.passage: Teak is among the most prized of the tropical hardwoods. It is native to India, Thailand, and Vietnam. It is a leaf-losing species that requires an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color. Teak is strong, making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture. One problem with harvesting teak is that the wood is very dense, so that when it is first felled and has not been dried it sinks in water. It cannot be moved out of forests by floating down rivers unless the wood has been dried first.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 값지고 단단하지만 고밀도라 건조 전 운반이 어렵다는 것이 요지.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 값짐+단단함+고밀도로 인한 운반 어려움 → 요지
❌ ① 가볍고 흔함 → 반대
❌ ② 우림에서만 자람 → 반대(우림엔 없음)
❌ ③ 관상용 재배 → 근거 없음
det.tip: prized/strong + very dense → 건조 전 운반 곤란

ch: 티크는 가볍고 흔해 누구나 쉽게 구할 수 있는 목재다.
티크는 열대우림에서만 자라는 희귀한 보호 수종이다.
티크는 값지고 단단한 목재지만 밀도가 높아 건조 전에는 운반이 어렵다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 알맞은 표현을 [조건]에 따라 영어로 쓰시오.

Teak is strong, making it __________ in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture.

[조건] (1) wood, valued, a를 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 3단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: a valued wood — making + it(목적어) + a valued wood(목적보어). 단단해서 귀중한 목재가 됨.
det.analysis: make A B(5형식): making it(A) a valued wood(B). 관사 a + 형용사 valued + 명사 wood
det.tip: making it + 명사구(a valued wood) = 5형식 목적보어
